title: Unable to set reasoning for gpt-oss when using ChatOllama
body:
### Checked other resources

- [x] This is a bug, not a usage question. For questions, please use the LangChain Forum (https://forum.langchain.com/).
- [x] I added a clear and descriptive title that summarizes this issue.
- [x] I used the GitHub search to find a similar question and didn't find it.
- [x] I am sure that this is a bug in LangChain rather than my code.
- [x] The bug is not resolved by updating to the latest stable version of LangChain (or the specific integration package).
- [x] I read what a minimal reproducible example is (https://stackoverflow.com/help/minimal-reproducible-example).
- [x] I posted a self-contained, minimal, reproducible example. A maintainer can copy it and run it AS IS.

### Example Code

I first installed `langchain==0.3.27` and `langchain_ollama==0.3.6`. Then I ran the following code:

```python
from langchain_ollama import ChatOllama

model = ChatOllama(model="gpt-oss:20b", reasoning="low")
```

### Error Message and Stack Trace (if applicable)

```
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/.../bug.py", line 3, in <module>
    model = ChatOllama(model="gpt-oss:20b", reasoning="low")
            ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/.../.venv/lib/python3.12/site-packages/langchain_core/load/serializable.py", line 130, in __init__
    super().__init__(*args, **kwargs)
  File "/.../.venv/lib/python3.12/site-packages/pydantic/main.py", line 253, in __init__
    validated_self = self.__pydantic_validator__.validate_python(data, self_instance=self)
                     ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
pydantic_core._pydantic_core.ValidationError: 1 validation error for ChatOllama
reasoning
  Input should be a valid boolean, unable to interpret input [type=bool_parsing, input_value='low', input_type=str]
    For further information visit https://errors.pydantic.dev/2.11/v/bool_parsing
```

### Description

Hi! I am trying to set the reasoning level to `"low"` for `gpt-oss:20b` when using `ChatOllama`. It appears that the reasoning level is currently required to be a boolean; as such, I am running into validation issues. However, `gpt-oss:20b` allows for setting the reasoning level to be `"low"/"medium"/"high"`. This is currently supported in the Ollama Python client with the `think` parameter, as shown here (to my understanding, `think` is equivalent to ChatOllama's `reasoning`): https://github.com/ollama/ollama-python/blob/main/examples/thinking-levels.py

Can `ChatOllama` be modified to allow string parameters for reasoning? I am happy to make this change, though I may need some guidance as a first-time contributor.

linked_prs.title: feat(ollama): update reasoning type to support string values for custom intensity levels (e.g. `gpt-oss`)

ai_judgment.response: Yes. This is an agent issue because it involves LLM provider integration (`ChatOllama` with `gpt-oss:20b`) and a misconfiguration of parameters (`reasoning`), which is tied to LLM operation and behavior within the agent system.
